title: Alla galleria d'arte: descrivere un dipinto e parlare di esperienze

alternatives: This picture is very vibrant.

sentences.it: I colori di questo quadro sono vividi.
sentences.en: The colours in this painting are vivid.
alternatives: The colors in this painting are vivid.
The colours of this painting are vivid.
The colors of this painting are vivid.
sentences.hint: to be + aggettivo — colours, painting, vivid

sentences.it: Preferisco l'arte astratta a quella realistica.
sentences.en: I prefer abstract art to realistic art.
alternatives: I prefer abstract art over realistic art.

sentences.it: Il suo ultimo quadro è un acquerello dall'atmosfera onirica.
sentences.en: His latest painting is a dreamlike watercolour.
alternatives: His latest painting is a dreamlike watercolor.
Her latest painting is a dreamlike watercolour.
Her latest painting is a dreamlike watercolor.
sentences.hint: aggettivo prima del nome — latest, dreamlike, watercolour

sentences.it: Ho trovato la mostra piuttosto noiosa.
sentences.en: I found the exhibition quite dull.
alternatives: I thought the exhibition was quite dull.
I found the exhibition rather dull.
sentences.hint: find + nome + aggettivo — exhibition, quite, dull

sentences.it: Lui ha visitato il Louvre a Parigi.
sentences.en: He has visited the Louvre in Paris.
alternatives: He's visited the Louvre in Paris.
He has been to the Louvre in Paris.
He's been to the Louvre in Paris.
sentences.hint: present perfect per un'esperienza — visit, Louvre

sentences.it: Non hanno mai visto la Gioconda.
sentences.en: They have never seen the Mona Lisa.
alternatives: They've never seen the Mona Lisa.
sentences.hint: present perfect con never — see, Mona Lisa

sentences.en: They haven't seen the Last Supper.
alternatives: They have not seen the Last Supper.
sentences.hint: present perfect negativo — see, Last Supper

sentences.it: Sei mai stato al museo Guggenheim?
sentences.en: Have you ever been to the Guggenheim Museum?
alternatives: Have you ever visited the Guggenheim Museum?
Have you ever been to the Guggenheim?
Have you ever visited the Guggenheim?
sentences.hint: domanda con have you ever + participio — be/visit, Guggenheim

alternatives: Yes, I have, too!
Yes, I've been there too!
sentences.hint: risposta breve + too — yes, I have

sentences.it: No, non ci sono stato neanch'io.
alternatives: No, I have not either.
No, I haven't been there either.
sentences.hint: risposta breve negativa + either — no, I haven't

sentences.it: Lei ha visitato il MoMA. Ci è andata l'anno scorso con la sua famiglia.
sentences.en: She has visited the MoMA. She went last year with her family.
alternatives: She's visited the MoMA. She went last year with her family.
She has visited the MoMA. She went there last year with her family.
She's visited the MoMA. She went there last year with her family.
sentences.hint: present perfect per l'esperienza, poi past simple per i dettagli — visit, go, last year

sentences.it: Hai un dipinto preferito? Come lo descriveresti?
sentences.en: Do you have a favourite painting? How would you describe it?
alternatives: Do you have a favorite painting? How would you describe it?
Have you got a favourite painting? How would you describe it?
sentences.hint: do you have + would per la domanda — favourite painting, describe

sentences.it: Mia sorella dipinge con la pittura acrilica, io preferisco la pittura a olio.
sentences.en: My sister paints with acrylic, I prefer oil.
alternatives: My sister paints with acrylics, I prefer oil.
My sister paints in acrylic, I prefer oil.
My sister paints with acrylic paint, I prefer oil paint.
sentences.hint: present simple — paint, acrylic, prefer, oil

sentences.it: Non sono mai stata alla Tate Modern di Londra.
sentences.en: I have never been to the Tate Modern in London.
alternatives: I've never been to the Tate Modern in London.
I have never visited the Tate Modern in London.
I've never visited the Tate Modern in London.
sentences.hint: present perfect con never — be/visit, Tate Modern

vocabulary.example: We spent the afternoon at an art gallery.
There's a beautiful painting above the sofa.
The city has a vibrant art scene.
vocabulary.mnemonic: «vibrant» come vibrare: un colore che vibra di energia.

vocabulary.example: His portraits are very realistic.
The film has a strange, dreamlike atmosphere.
She painted the flowers in vivid colours.
The lecture was long and dull.
I don't understand abstract art.
Acrylic dries very quickly.
The artist used spray paint on the wall.
She painted the lake in watercolour.
He makes digital art on his tablet.
This portrait is painted in oil.
Children often paint with tempera at school.
The art museum is free on Sundays.
The Mona Lisa is smaller than I expected.
vocabulary.mnemonic: In inglese è «Mona Lisa», da «Monna Lisa», il nome della donna ritratta.

vocabulary.example: The Last Supper is in Milan.
vocabulary.mnemonic: «supper» è la cena della sera, come «soup» (zuppa) per cena.

vocabulary.example: What's your favourite painting?
Can you describe the painting?
The exhibition opens next Friday.
vocabulary.mnemonic: non è «show» come spettacolo: per l'arte si dice «exhibition», come esibizione.

vocabulary.example: We visited the Uffizi Gallery in Florence.

grammar.title: Descrivere un dipinto
grammar.body:
## Gli aggettivi

| Aggettivo | Significato |
| --- | --- |
| *vibrant* | vivace, pieno di energia e di vita |
| *realistic* | realistico, molto simile alla realtà |
| *dreamlike* | onirico, irreale come un sogno |
| *vivid* | vivido, dai colori intensi che restano in mente |
| *dull* | noioso, spento, che annoia |
| *abstract* | astratto, fatto di forme e colori, non rappresenta la realtà |

## Le tecniche

- *acrylic* — pittura acrilica
- *spray* — pittura spray
- *watercolour* (americano *watercolor*) — acquerello
- *digital* — arte digitale
- *oil* — pittura a olio
- *tempera* — tempera

## Frasi utili

- *It's a vibrant abstract painting.* — È un dipinto astratto vivace.
- *The colours are very vivid.* — I colori sono molto vividi.
- *I found it quite dull.* — L'ho trovato piuttosto noioso.

Per parlare dei musei che hai visitato si usa il *present perfect* (vedi la lezione «Have you ever…?»): *Have you ever been to the Louvre?* — *Yes, I have!*
